value.note: Full Swing Crystal Oscillator range. The Low Power oscillator mode covers 0.4-16.0 MHz (Table 9-3, p.39). Recommended C1/C2 is 12-22 pF in both tables; AVR042 §5.3 (p.15) widens that to 22-33 pF for standard high-frequency crystals. An external crystal is OPTIONAL — the calibrated internal RC oscillator is a valid clock source (Table 9-1, p.37) — so absence of a crystal is not a violation.

value.note: Keep the distance between the crystal/capacitors and the MCU short, and surround the crystal with a ground plane whose vias sit close to the MCU pins (AVR042 §6 checklist items 4 and 5, p.17). No numeric distance and no explicit under-crystal keepout are stated, so neither is asserted here.

cap.note: AREF must also be decoupled; the typical value for the capacitor is 100 nF.

value.per_supply_pair_note: For devices with multiple pairs of power and ground pins it is essential that there is a decoupling capacitor for every pair of pins (AVR042 §2.1, p.5). AVR042 states the COUNT but no capacitance for the digital VCC/GND pairs, so the value stays unasserted here instead of being inferred as 100 nF — the 100 nF figure on p.5 belongs to AREF / the analog supply.

bulk.text: The main power supply should also have a tantalum or ceramic capacitor to stabilize it. No capacitance is stated.

value.placement_note: Place decoupling capacitors very close to the die; a capacitor placed too far away creates a large high-current loop and spreads noise through the planes (AVR042 §2.1 and Figure 2-1, p.4-5). AVCC must be decoupled separately from VCC and isolated from it; with a separate AGND, analog and digital ground join at a single point at the supply GND (AVR042 §2.2 p.5, §6 item 3 p.17). No numeric distance is stated.

value.details: Four reset sources: power-on, external RESET, watchdog and brown-out (DS §11.1, p.56). The RESET line has an internal pull-up, so no external reset circuit is required (AVR042 §3, p.6). AVR042 nevertheless recommends an external pull-up in noisy environments: >=4.7 kOhm when programming with STK600, and not less than 10 kOhm for DebugWIRE to work; the optional RESET-to-GND capacitor must NOT be fitted when DebugWIRE is used (AVR042 §3, p.6, Figure 3-1 shows 4.7 kOhm + 100 nF as a typical example). Minimum reset pulse width is 2.5 us and VRST is 0.2-0.9 VCC (DS Table 29-11, p.314). RESET has its own absolute maximum range of -0.5 V to +13.0 V, distinct from ordinary I/O (DS §29.1, p.308).

source.ref: §11.1 Resetting the AVR p.56; §11.4 External Reset p.58; Table 29-11 p.314

boot_strapping.reason: The AVR has no boot/strapping pins: the clock source is selected by the CKSEL fuses and reset behaviour by the RSTDISBL fuse, not by pin states sampled at power-up (DS Table 9-1 p.37; RSTDISBL p.95).

mandatory_peripherals.reason: No external part is mandatory for the device to run: program memory is on-chip and the calibrated internal RC oscillator is a valid clock source (DS Table 9-1 Device Clocking Options, p.37).
